classification_finding.observed: The Free Tier 429 body for the frozen model uses the same 'You exceeded your current quota' wording for a short-window request limit as for daily exhaustion, and separates them only by a 'Please retry in <N>s' hint (18.0s and 8.4s were observed).
classification_finding.consequence_before_the_fix: The pilot stopped twice with BLOCKED_QUOTA and the block artifact said 'daily quota exhaustion' for a limit that cleared in seconds.
classification_finding.evidence_it_was_transient: After waiting, the same frozen request succeeded; the run resumed and completed without any contract change.
classification_finding.fix: prism_fas.llm.providers.gemini._classify now classifies a 429 by its replenishment hint. A hint within the retry ceiling and not naming a per-day metric is RATE_LIMIT (bounded backoff); anything else still fails closed as QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.

pacing.nature: operational scheduling only - it changes when a request is sent, never what is sent, and it is not part of the frozen retry policy
